summary: This change moves chat attachments to a chunked, resumable upload API. Uploads are claimed when a prompt is accepted and released when it is rejected, and files too large to include are passed to the model as workspace paths. The coverage gate now passes: lines 224 and 327 of UploadService.ts and line 288 of AgentPane.tsx are covered by temp tests. The `wait()` early-abort branch in uploadChatFile.ts is exempt because only a race reaches it (uploadError() already handles earlier aborts), and I accept that reason. Both earlier findings are resolved, all test runs pass, and no P0 or P1 issues remain.
